ache.title: Expiring tickets: the FOMO he warned you about
ache.note: An urgent alarm: the skin tickets you collected won’t carry over to the next banner and will expire soon. Expiry dates make what you already spent feel about to be wasted, so you spend more to “finish.” To his credit, he warns against impulsive FOMO spending. Listen to that part. Let the tickets go.
watch: tickets that expire with the banner
ache.tip: When tickets are about to expire, let them. Losing a few tickets costs less than chasing them.

let them expire. it’s okay. really
good advice from past-Nero, for once

textData.text: Inside the Loop: I made this while I was caught in the gacha loop. It stays up as a record of that time, not as advice.

this urgent Pokémon Unite update, I discuss important information for players collecting tickets for skins. Contrary to expectations, these tickets won't transfer to the next banner and will expire soon. With high costs involved, I advise players to check their progress and avoid impulsive spending due to fear of missing out. Future legendary skins may follow the same model, increasing the need to be cautious. Learn from players like ChrisHeroes and reach out for advice to avoid financial pitfalls.
